entities.summary: Qingdao University of Technology, formerly known as Qingdao Technological University,is a key provincial comprehensive university in Qingdao, Shandong, China. It offers programs in civil, mechanical, and environmental engineering. The university is part of Plan 111 and Outstanding Engineer Education and Training Program.
